posts.author: Apocalypticat
posts.body:
Hi all.
I have (reluctantly) come to a point in development where I realized that paralax mapping would be the best way to go forward. The problem is, I am a bit unsure which plugins etc I should use in my case.
I am using pixel movement, and I would obviously prefer it if the collisions are not grid-based. I understand the layered notion of paralax maps and can create them in Gimp etc, so that part isn't an issue.
So, could anyone perhaps suggest plugins for the paralax mapping & collision for such maps (non-grid based)?
Thanks in advance.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
In MV and MZ parallax mapping is supported by the base engine, no need for a plugin.
a plugin is only needed if you want to go a step further into overlay mapping (more than one layer for your maps). If you only want to use the parallax, simply use a filename for the background pictures that begins with a !
that will show the engine to disable the parallax (movement) and use the slot for a background map.
and collision has absolutely nothing to do with that.
If you're using a pixel movement plugin, then you need a collision plugin that is specifically compatible to the pixel movement plugin.
That is the only requirement, it has nothing to do with mapping as such.

posts.author: ZimXero
posts.body:
Galv's Layers is probably the most powerful layering plugin at the moment.  It allows infinite layers placeable in any order at three locations:
Below maker map
Above maker map, under characters
Over characters
If you are asking about apps to create parallax maps... VS Tiled is free and can do just about anything.   It has a steep learning curve but lots of vid tutorials.  Gimp is a great fallback editor, but could be used as a primary means if you are good with it.  You can map in RPG maker, save the map, and use it as a template to generate your layers.
